name: US equity stress
summary: S&P 500 closed near 7,237 on 23 Nov, 7.4% below its high; VIX at 26.6, inside the Watch band
state: The S&P 500 closed near 7,237 on 23 Nov, 7.4% below its 52-week high and 1.4% lower on the week, after a worst day of -3.7% in the past five sessions (Yahoo Finance). The VIX closed near 26.6, down from 35.9 on 20 Nov and back below the 30 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Both readings sit in the Watch band, and no circuit breaker tripped.
for_you: Pension and investment values linked to US shares remain exposed to swings. Market volatility tends to ease or deepen with news on the Gulf conflict and interest rates.
rubric_hit: VIX 28.8 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 7.44% ≥ 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
